column1: # Numbering in the formalization is that of the published version; labels are those of the arXiv v1 TeX.
# 2taxnetblo: "straightforward to prove"; the paper prints no proof.
# cor:partiofparti: proved in the sentence before it, from 2taxnetblo.
# ex::nmsc: Example 1 illustrates the model; it states no result.
# cor:2isgood: "Together, the preceding Lemmas yield the following": proved in running text.
# cor::quartetisgood: follows from thm::MRCA and prop::CFunrooted (the paper states it after both).
# ex:2_2, ex:3_1, ex:4_1, ex:3_2: computed in the text "By Lemma 9/10/11, with x_i = e^{-t_i}", from equation (1).
# ex::cpbc, ex::cpbc4: evaluations of equations (9) and (8).
# thm::twocor: "follows immediately from" prop:BCgenerically and prop:Bc4cycle1dir.
# cor::Cpgen: "Theorem 3 and Proposition 8 yield the following".
# obs:quartetcoales: Observation 1 (environment `obs`, not seen by the extraction); stated without proof.
# CFtree: equation (1), the CFs of a quartet tree, "known" from Allman, Degnan, Rhodes 2011 [1]; a cited result.
# pub:prop3, pub:prop4: Propositions 3 and 4 of the published version, absent from arXiv v1 (no TeX label); "proven in [1]" (Allman, Degnan, Rhodes 2011).
# pub:prop12: Proposition 12, unlabelled in the TeX (line 1209); its proof cites Propositions 8 and 7.
# ext:semple-steel: Semple, Steel 2003 [22], the quartets of a tree determine it; cited in the proof of thm::main.
# pub:rootplace: the root placement does not change the concordance factors of a species tree (Section 4, "it is known ... [1]"); a cited result.
